نتفيهق (form IIq)
# نَتَفَيْهَقُ (natafayhaqu) /na.ta.faj.ha.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَيْهَقَ (tafayhaqa)
# نَتَفَيْهَقَ (natafayhaqa) /na.ta.faj.ha.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَيْهَقَ (tafayhaqa)
# نَتَفَيْهَقْ (natafayhaq) /na.ta.faj.haq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَيْهَقَ (tafayhaqa)
